input.subject: Toilet flush repair – Flat 10, 130 Lantern Quay (Ref R/PM032-1)
input.body:
Hello,

An update on the toilet flush in the second bedroom at Flat 10, 130 Lantern Quay, Willowbank, ZZ5 1ZZ (Ref R/PM032-1): your landlord has agreed to the repair, and we are now arranging a contractor. We will be in touch to agree an appointment. Nothing is booked yet.

In the meantime, if the toilet runs constantly or leaks, you can turn off the isolation valve on the pipe feeding the cistern (usually a small screw you turn a quarter turn with a flat screwdriver). Please let us know straight away if any water escapes onto the floor.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance Team
